probe.text_sample: About us | Cloudflare Products Solutions Resources Pricing Login Dashboard Contact sales Start building Dashboard Login Help us build a better Internet We have our eyes set on an ambitious goal — to help build a better Internet. We believe that with our talented team, smart technology, and engaged users we can solve some of the biggest problems on the Internet. Just how big? Read our story See open positions Push to deploy Anytime we push code, it automatically affects millions of Internet properties within seconds, with zero downtime. Constant growth Every day, thousands of new customers sign up for Cloudflare — from independent developers to the world's largest enterprises. Massive scale We serve an average of 102 million HTTP requests per second , and proxy roughly 20% of the web's traffic. Global reach We serve data from 335 cities in over 125 countries — putting our network within milliseconds of nearly everyone on Earth. One connectivity cloud Sixty-plus services across SASE, application security, performance, and full-stack development — all on the same global network.
